lead: Write a differential sweep as one `--ORACLE--` case and let the runner partition it.
body: An oracle failure prints PHP's whole output beside Novis's, so one run says which subjects agree; the rest become a second case with an `--ORACLE-DIVERGES--` line. Substitute control bytes on both sides first (`Core\Str::replaceAll` against PHP's `strtr`), because `rule:tooling/terminal-output-is-a-sink` renders a band wider than CR and LF.
